Staff Vacancy
Monday, 13 January 2020
16835 Hits
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital invites applications on plain paper for the following posts. The applicant should send their applications along with the attested copies of educational qualification and experience to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) until
31/01/2020.
Post
Qualification & Experience
Social Worker- 1
MSW from any recognized University should have worked in a teaching 500 bedded medical institute, with at least five years experience Sound knowledge of PCPNDT Act.
(Cast – Open 1)
Physiotherapist- 1
The candidate should have obtained graduation in Physiotherapy and should have worked in at least 500 bedded teaching hospital for at least three years.
(Cast – Open 1)
Staff Nurse- 30
12th + General Nursing & Midwifery Course & Must have 5 years experience in any 100 bedded hospital/institute.
(Cast – ST 4, SEBC 6, VJNT 5, EWS 5, OPEN 10 )
Psychiatric Nurse – 1
12th + General Nursing & Midwifery Course & 5 years experience in any 100 bedded hospital/institute. Specialized training psychiatric nursing.
(Cast – Open 1)
Driver - 4
H.S.S.C. having Permanent License of Driving Heavy Vehicle & 5 years experience in any reputed Organization.
(Cast – Open 1, SEBC 2, EWS 1)
MRI/CT Technician - 1
B.Sc. with Physics, Chemistry or Biology/Diploma in CT/MRI, Must have 5 years experience in any 100 bedded hospital.
(Cast – VJNT 1,)
Click here to download the form
Note: Age Limit:  Age and experience shall be relaxed for an exceptional and suitable candidate.
For more details please contact:
Phone: 07152 -284341 to 284355 (Ext. 201)
Email:
mspis@mgims.ac.in
Website: www.mgims.ac.in
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
